## s13-v07 — argument map

Yady athāsthitapadārthadarśanaṃ yuṣmadarcanamahotsavaś ca yaḥ: if seeing things as they stand and worship-festival — yugmam etad itaretarāśrayaṃ bhaktiśāliṣu sadā vijṛmbhate: this pair mutually grounds, always blooms in devotees. Seeing and worship-festival mutually ground each other in devotees.

### Open
- Whether 'yugmam' means 'pair' or 'couple' is unresolved.
- Whether 'itaretarāśraya' means 'mutually grounding' or 'reciprocal support' is unresolved.
